meta.program_class: OVERLAY-VALIDATION (benchmark-relative gate), NOT edge-certification; DSR/PBO informational only, expected low at breadth=2

S3_tilt_window.note: S3 tilts touch a small number of single days (~5/month + ~1/FOMC out of ~2000 total trading days); the canary's effect size on full-sample Sharpe is expected to be much smaller than S1/S2's canaries, which corrupt the ENTIRE exposure history. Reported honestly rather than expecting the same order-of-magnitude inflation.

2018Q4_chop_SPYUSDT.warmup_caveat: S1's 200d SMA / 252d-return / 210d-SMA components require data through ~2019-02 (SMA) to ~2019-06 (12mo total-return sign) before they first validate, given SPY/QQQ duka history starts 2018-05-01; a zero-flip, all-zero-exposure result in the 2018Q4 window is therefore a DATA-COVERAGE ARTIFACT (pre-warmup), NOT evidence the filter cleanly avoided whipsaw in a live chop regime.

6_turnover_sanity_5_to_15_per_year.definition: sum(|delta_exposure|) / 2 / n_years -- a full 0->1->0 round trip sums |delta_exposure| to 2.0; this is the correct operationalization of I1_PREREG.md's 'full round-trip-equivalent exposure changes per year', NOT a raw day-count of any nonzero delta (S2's continuously-recomputed vol-target scale makes nearly every day show some tiny nonzero delta).
